description: One row per source UniProtKB accession (5,466) mapping to a stable MicroRhodoDB accession (MRDB######); many-to-one (5,299 distinct MRDB accessions), with source_database, release_added and is_current.

Links between evidence assertions/records and supporting publications.

Function-call benchmark (v2) scores per record under different cross-validation schemes.
Per-table build provenance: source data file, generating script, algorithm, parameters, upstream dependencies, release and build timestamp.
